messages:
maya: Dropping a new set of mocks for the Spend overview. Key review asks: scope language (Org vs Project), density of the token breakdown grid, invoice download affordance, and mobile hit targets. Figma link: https://www.figma.com/file/zzzzz

sam: Nice iterations. My quick take: the left rail with scope toggle is visually heavy and pushes the main chart too far right on small widths. Could we try a compact toggle that collapses into a pill above the chart at <960px?

ellie: Agree the rail dominates. Accessibility flag: the token legend contrast is around 3.8:1. Target is 4.5:1 for body copy; please bump the label weight or darken the color.

noah: Copy thought: current toggle reads "Account / Project" which feels terse. Suggest "View by: Organization / Project" to give context.

maya: I like the copy but also wonder about defaults. Should org-admins default to Org, but let users pin a preference? If so, the pin needs to be unobtrusive.

sam: Inferred default is fine. UX: show a subtle status pill under the header like "Viewing: Organization" that doubles as the toggle opener. Keyboard-focusable.

design-bot: Please run automated a11y checks (axe/pa11y) on the prototype before Thursday demo.

ellie: Interaction notes: make sure tab order flows: scope pill -> date range -> export CTA -> main chart. Charts must include descriptive aria labels (e.g., `aria-label="Spend chart: past 30 days, stacked by model"`).

noah: Token breakdown: 3-column grid looks cramped on widescreens for content-dense accounts. Proposal: responsive cols: 3 desktop, 2 tablet, 1 mobile. Also add short hover tooltip explaining billing split: prompt vs response tokens.

maya: Thoughts on invoice button placement: options are 1) prominent top-right CTA, 2) small inline button next to "Billing period" header, 3) row-level action in invoice list. I lean to 2 to avoid competing with primary chart actions.

sam: Agree with 2. Keep it a secondary button: `Download invoice`. Not a primary CTA. Place it in header near period selector.

ellie: Accessibility: ensure that the invoice control is a real button (not just a link) and that it has `aria-describedby` pointing to invoice status text (e.g., "Ready" or "Processing"). Keyboard users should find it in heading flow.

noah: Performance: donut + sparkline are causing reflows on tooltip hover. Suggest decoupling tooltip rendering from SVG drives — render overlays in a separate layer to avoid redraw. Eng-runtime can implement a shallow repaint here.

maya: Will sync with eng-runtime. Also want consistent token label copy: currently mixing "Prompt Tokens" and "Input Tokens". Propose using `Prompt (tokens)` and `Response (tokens)` and a tiny info icon linking to docs.

sam: +1. Ensure info icon has accessible text: `aria-label="What counts as a prompt token"`.

ellie: Mobile: increase legend tappable area to at least 44x44px. We saw misses in testing when dots were small. Also reduce animation durations <120ms and respect prefers-reduced-motion.

maya: Pin-to-default idea: small star on the scope pill. If user pins, persist in profile. But default state should be unobtrusive.

noah: UX question: if a user pins a project, should org-level billing admins still see an override? Maybe show a parent-level toggle in settings. We can follow-up with PMs.

sam: Minor: change header copy from "Account spend" to "Billing: usage overview" to be clearer for new users.

ellie: I'll compile an a11y checklist: contrast, tab order, hit targets, aria labels, reduced-motion, focus outlines. Will share as a checklist in the thread.

maya: Great. Action items: ellie -> accessibility checklist; noah -> perf approach with eng-runtime; sam -> implement copy updates & place invoice CTA inline; maya -> update Figma with compact toggle and pin mockups. Reconvene Friday. :thumbsup:
